changeLaterNoPage: Ka taea e koe te huri i tēnei i ngā wā katoa mā te ūkui i ngā raraunga o tēnei pae i tō pūtirotiro.
savedAllow: Kua tiakina: kua whakaaetia a Google Analytics.
savedDeny: Kua tiakina: ka noho weto tonu a Google Analytics.
analyticsTitle: Me whakaae ki a Google Analytics?
analyticsBody: Ka whakamahia e tēnei pae hei tatau i ngā toronga me ngā whārangi kua pānuihia. Ki te whakaae koe, ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete. Kei te pai te kī kāo: ka rite tonu te mahi a te pae.
genericNotice: Nō {host} tēnei ihirangi. Ka whiwhi a {host} i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceNotice_youtube: Ka purei tēnei ataata mai i YouTube. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceNotice_vimeo: Ka purei tēnei ataata mai i Vimeo. Ka whiwhi a Vimeo i tō wāhitau IP.
serviceNotice_google_maps: Nō Google Maps tēnei mahere. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceNotice_speech: Ka tukuna e tō pūtirotiro tō reo ki tāna ratonga reo (Google, Apple, Microsoft rānei) hei huri ki te kupu tuhituhi.
serviceNotice_github: Nō GitHub tēnei ihirangi. Ka whiwhi a GitHub i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceNotice_webstatus: Nō webstatus.dev tēnei tūnga Baseline, he kaupapa Google Chrome. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP.
serviceNotice_aframe: Me whai tēnei whakaaturanga 3D i te pātaka A-Frame mai i aframe.io. Ka whiwhi a aframe.io i tō wāhitau IP.
